backend/main.mo: Main ICP actor that composes authorization and blob-storage mixins, and defines types and methods for user credentials, profiles, ML predictions, and medical file metadata with role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Build-planning report listing two proposed cleanup features: removing the deprecated reportMetadataStore.ts and removing this feature_evidence.json file itself, both marked high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-to-two sentence summaries of all frontend source files, used as a reference document for build planning.
frontend/DEPLOY_NOTES.md: Documents three deployment fixes: replacing Node.js process.env with Vite import.meta.env for the II URL, removing duplicate provider wrappers from main.tsx, and confirming correct provider composition order in App.tsx.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes covering background, foreground, chart, and sidebar color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the Vite module entry point at src/main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (welcome, auth, home, profile, chat, report, medications) and wraps them in the full provider tree including ThemeProvider, DesignBProvider, QueryClientProvider, and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/auth/demoCredentialStore.ts: localStorage-backed demo credential store providing createAccount, verifyCredentials, and getAccount functions with phone-number uniqueness enforcement and simple password hashing for UI-level auth.
frontend/src/auth/demoCredentialTypes.ts: TypeScript interface definitions for DemoAccount, VerifyCredentialsResult, and CreateAccountResult used by the demo credential store.
frontend/src/auth/session.ts: Manages local authentication sessions (OTP, password, guest) using localStorage with 30-day expiry, providing save, load, clear, and validation utilities.
frontend/src/components/assistant/assist: Core logic for processing user input, detecting emergencies, greetings, navigation intents, and matching medical/specialty knowledge base entries to generate assistant responses.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Assist: Renders the chat transcript panel for the AI assistant, including a welcome/empty state with suggested prompts, capability badges, specialty badges, message list, and a typing indicator.
frontend/src/components/assistant/assist: Handles localStorage persistence for the healthcare assistant transcript, including save, load, and clear operations with migration support from v1 and v2 formats to v3.
Defines TypeScript types and interfaces used across the assistant feature, including message roles, confidence levels, assistant status, command results, and specialty filters.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Assist: A floating assistant widget that opens a sheet with a chat interface supporting text input, speech recognition, specialty filtering, and navigation actions via the assistant brain.
frontend/src/components/assistant/custom: Empty file, likely a placeholder for custom Q&A pair persistence logic.
Empty file, likely a placeholder for TypeScript types related to custom Q&A functionality.
frontend/src/components/assistant/fuzzyQ: Empty file, likely a placeholder for fuzzy matching logic to find approximate Q&A matches.
frontend/src/components/assistant/genera: Defines a static knowledge base of general health topics (e.g., immune system, vaccines, inflammation) with keyword arrays and detailed markdown responses.
frontend/src/components/assistant/langua: Provides client-side language detection using character range analysis and word/pattern matching, supporting over 20 languages without external APIs.
frontend/src/components/assistant/medica: Contains a large static array of medical topics (cardiology, dermatology, etc.) with associated keywords and structured markdown responses covering diagnosis, treatment, and prevention.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Messag: Parses and renders markdown-like assistant message content (headings, lists, tables, blockquotes, bold, inline code) into styled React elements.
frontend/src/components/assistant/messag: Provides deterministic summarization of long assistant messages into concise bullet points, preserving medical terminology, emergency indicators, and action items.
frontend/src/components/assistant/multil: Defines multilingual response templates for 8 supported languages (en, es, fr, de, zh, ar, hi, pt), covering greetings, help text, emergency prefixes, and error messages for the AI assistant.
frontend/src/components/assistant/report: Provides deterministic, pattern-based analysis of medical report text, extracting key findings, generating interpretations for common lab values, suggesting actions, and identifying red flags without using AI/LLM.
Extracts text from uploaded report files by detecting text-based formats via extension/content-type and decoding bytes as UTF-8, rejecting binary or invalid content.
frontend/src/components/assistant/respon: Formats AI assistant responses with empathetic openings, specialty attribution headers, and medical disclaimers, supporting informational, urgent, reassuring, and general tones.
frontend/src/components/assistant/specia: Contains a structured knowledge base of medical specialties (e.g., cardiology, dermatology) with keywords, conditions, symptoms, diagnostic tools, treatments, red flags, and formatted educational content.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Sugges: A styled button chip component that displays a suggested prompt with an optional emoji icon and triggers a callback when clicked.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Typing: Displays an animated three-dot typing indicator with the assistant avatar to indicate the assistant is processing a response.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useAss: React hook that manages the assistant chat transcript state, persisting messages to storage and providing utilities to add, toggle expansion of, and clear messages.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useSpe: A React hook that wraps the Web Speech Recognition API, providing transcript state, interim results, confidence levels, and automatic retry logic with error handling.
A React hook that wraps the Web Speech Synthesis API, exposing speak, cancel, and toggle functions along with speaking/enabled state.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useTra: A React hook that manages auto-scrolling of a transcript container, tracking whether the user is near the bottom and only auto-scrolling when appropriate.
frontend/src/components/CloseButton.tsx: A fixed-position close button component that navigates to '/home' by default or calls an optional onClick handler.
frontend/src/designB/components/Dashboar: A presentational component rendering a section header with a title, optional caption, and an optional action element aligned to the right.
A flexible dashboard tile component that displays an icon, label, value, and caption with configurable color accents, sizes, and interactive states including an optional close button.
frontend/src/designB/components/DesignBS: A simple wrapper component that applies card background styling with three variants: default, elevated (with shadow), and outlined (with border).
frontend/src/designB/components/DesignBT: Exports four typed typography components (PageTitle, SectionTitle, Caption, BodyText) with consistent Tailwind-based text styling.
frontend/src/designB/components/ThemeSwi: A toggle switch component that switches between the default and Design B themes using the DesignB context.
frontend/src/designB/data/placeholders.t: Exports a mock user profile generated with a fixed seed using a flaker utility for consistent demo data.
frontend/src/designB/layout/DesignBAppSh: The main app shell layout for Design B, composing a sticky header, outlet, bottom navigation, voice assistant widget, and footer with conditional rendering based on route and auth state.
frontend/src/designB/layout/DesignBBotto: A fixed bottom navigation bar with tabs for Home, Reports, and Profile, highlighting the active route.
frontend/src/designB/storage/themePrefer: Utility functions to persist and retrieve the selected design theme ('default' or 'designB') from localStorage.
frontend/src/designB/theme.ts: Defines the Design B theme constants (palette, fonts, spacing, radius) and exports functions to apply or remove the theme via a data attribute on the document root.
frontend/src/designB/themeContext.tsx: Provides a React context and provider for managing the active design theme, persisting changes to localStorage and syncing the data attribute on the document root.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) actors, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthSession.ts: Provides callbacks to save and clear local authentication sessions for OTP, password, and guest sign-in types using the session utility module.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendCredentials: Exposes React Query hooks for checking, adding, and verifying user credentials against the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useDemoOtp.ts: Manages a client-side demo OTP session with 6-digit code generation, expiry validation, and a resend cooldown timer.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context and custom hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useMedicalFiles.ts: Manages medical file operations (list, upload, delete, download, get bytes) against the ICP backend using React Query mutations and queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains React Query hooks for backend data fetching, including a placeholder example query and a hook to fetch the current caller's user profile.
frontend/src/hooks/useRedirectIfAuthenti: Redirects already-authenticated users (via Internet Identity or local session) away from public pages to /home.
frontend/src/hooks/useRequireAuth.ts: Route guard hook that redirects unauthenticated users to /signin, checking both Internet Identity and local session state.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDisplayName.ts: Resolves a display name for the current user by checking profile data, local session info, and Internet Identity principal in priority order.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines CSS custom properties for light, dark, and designB themes including colors, radius, and sidebar variables.
frontend/src/lib/flaker.ts: Deterministic fake data generator using a seeded PRNG (mulberry32) to produce realistic demo user profiles including names, emails, phone numbers, blood types, allergies, and emergency contacts.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility module exporting a `cn` helper that merges Tailwind class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AppointmentDetails.ts: Empty file with no content; likely a placeholder for an appointment details page.
frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx: Full-featured medical chat page with message history, speech recognition, specialty filtering, suggested prompts, and an AI assistant brain integration for health Q&A.
frontend/src/pages/Chatbot.tsx: Empty file with no content; likely a placeholder for a chatbot page.
frontend/src/pages/DoctorList.tsx: Empty file with no content; likely a placeholder for a doctor listing page.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Health dashboard home page displaying today's metrics (heart rate, steps, hydration, calories) and quick-action tiles for navigating to health tools like the chatbot and other features.
frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboard.tsx: Empty file with no content; likely a placeholder for an alternative home dashboard page.
frontend/src/pages/Locate.tsx: Empty file with no content; likely a placeholder for a location/map page.
frontend/src/pages/Medications.tsx: Medications page that displays a daily medication schedule with taken/untaken status and reminder times, using auth guard and design system components.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundRedirect.tsx: Redirect component that automatically navigates users from unknown or removed routes to the /home page on mount.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Profile page that displays and allows editing of personal/medical information (name, blood type, allergies, emergency contact) with validation, and includes a sign-out action.
frontend/src/pages/Report.tsx: Medical Reports page that lets authenticated users upload, view, and delete medical documents, with file size formatting and upload status feedback.
frontend/src/pages/SignIn.tsx: Sign-in page supporting three authentication methods: OTP via phone, password-based login, and Internet Identity, with session initialization and redirect-if-authenticated guard.
frontend/src/pages/SignUp.tsx: Sign-up page that creates a new account with full name, phone, and password, stores credentials in the backend, initializes a local profile, and redirects to home on success.
frontend/src/pages/Welcome.tsx: Landing/welcome page showing the app logo, hero image, and feature highlights with buttons to navigate to sign-in or continue as a guest.
frontend/src/profile/profileBackendMappe: Utility module providing bidirectional mapping functions between the backend UserProfile type and the frontend ProfileDetails type, including blood type enum conversion and bigint/date-string conversion.
frontend/src/profile/profileLocalStore.t: Provides localStorage-based CRUD functions for profile data, keyed by session type (phone number for password/OTP sessions, stable guest ID for guest sessions), with a merge utility to initialize profile fields from auth data without overwriting existing values.
frontend/src/profile/profileTypes.ts: Defines the `ProfileDetails` TypeScript interface for editable user profile data, along with helper functions to create an empty profile object and check if a profile has any saved values.
frontend/src/profile/profileValidation.t: Exports a `validateProfileDetails` function that checks a `ProfileDetails` object for required fields, email format, phone length/format, and emergency contact completeness, returning a list of human-readable error messages.
frontend/src/profile/useProfileDetails.t: React Query hook that fetches and saves user profile details, routing to the ICP backend for Internet Identity sessions and to localStorage for local (password/OTP/guest) sessions.
Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/utils/frontendEnv.ts: Reads the Internet Identity provider URL from the `VITE_II_URL` environment variable with a fallback to the production II URL, and exposes it via `getInternetIdentityUrl` and `getFrontendConfig`.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive parameters from the URL hash without a page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that enables dark mode, registers typography/container-queries/animate plugins, and extends the theme with custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Build-planning state file tracking the project name, existing completed features, and a pending action request (AR-1) to delete all confirmed-empty frontend source files.
